_comment: WO-008 event data. Sorted by start date when the page is built. Year 2026 assumed (not shown on the supplied graphic) - confirm before publishing. Webinar length 60 minutes assumed. Add "registrationUrl" to an event to show a "Register for this event" button (opens in a new tab). Set "hidden": true to leave an event off the page without deleting it. Site-specific links are under "sites": production uses /index.php/ URLs, staging uses clean URLs. Set the uploads month to the month the files are uploaded. Optional per event: "stand" (shows a STAND sticker), "mapQuery" (Google Maps search for the pin link), "description". Optional "logo": {file,width,height} for a logo already in the Media Library (overrides pages/logos). Optional "registrationText" changes the Register button label.
